cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The wedding venue has made a small change.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. The date remains available. The building does not.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fire. Let's hold onto the available date while we choose what comes next.

confusable: D183 maintains one safe simplified account; D231 progressively changes what earlier statements mean.
comparison: Wedding logistics and reassurance differ from personal object damage and restoration.
seedUse: Keep available-date/building/fire sequence but make protecting B explicit through useful disclosure and next-step guidance.
